name: The Marble Solarium
tagline: Truth hides where the sunlight cuts deepest.
synopsis: An antique chess grandmaster dies in a locked observatory, leaving behind a board of contradictory moves. An insurance actuary and a disgraced cartographer must decipher the room's optical puzzles before midnight.

name: Cipher of the Void
tagline: Before we answer, we must first learn silence.
synopsis: A dormant deep-sea communication relay begins transmitting geometric acoustic pulses from the Mariana Trench. A marine paleoclimatologist must decode the sub-aquatic transmissions before competing naval fleets initiate seismic drilling.

name: The Velvet Crest
tagline: Prestige, pastry, and high-altitude pandemonium.
synopsis: Two rival carriage restorers accidentally swap identical luggage containing a priceless imperial crown. Racing down winding mountain passes in custom roadsters, they must retrieve the jewel before an international exhibition.

name: Prism Sector
tagline: Every frequency reveals a different hero.
synopsis: A roller-derby courier in a subterranean synth city discovers that solar flares are overlapping urban frequencies. She must skate across vibrating dimensional rifts with alternate skyline racers to reignite the power grid.

name: Quantum Reach
tagline: Every choice has a twin looking right back.
synopsis: A weary antique clock repairer drops a balance spring into a temporal fault, splitting her workshop into hundreds of coexisting realities. To stop an entropic collapse, she must coordinate repairs with versions of herself across divergent lives.

name: Brass and Iron
tagline: Perfection takes no prisoners in the foundry.
synopsis: A bell caster's apprentice enters the prestigious cathedral chime guild under a legendary, ruthless master. As the casting deadline for the town cathedral looms, he works through burns and exhaustion to tune the master carillon.

name: Shrine of Shadows
tagline: Between twilight and morning, the spirits awaken.
synopsis: An apprentice weaver follows an escaped silk moth into a hidden cloud valley governed by river spirits. To purchase her ticket across the celestial ferry, she must weave tapestries commemorating forgotten folk legends.

name: Bramble Quest
tagline: Little paws can outwit the tallest castles.
synopsis: A colony of field mice invents glider kites to outmaneuver an owl baron who claimed their winter grain silos. Working against the approaching frost, the smallest rodent engineers an audacious mid-air heist.

name: Silent Perimeter
tagline: If the wind dies, do not move an inch.
synopsis: At an atmospheric monitoring outpost surrounded by sound-sensitive desert stalkers, a crew's seismic dampener malfunctions. When night storms cut electrical power, two meteorologists must crawl across open desert in total stillness.

name: The Hollow Estate
tagline: Polite smiles can hide the deepest traps.
synopsis: An acoustic technician arrives at a renowned private wellness retreat to install sensory isolation chambers. When guests begin mimicking identical childhood mannerisms, he discovers a hypnotic conditioning syndicate operating beneath the spa.

name: Mirage at Dawn
tagline: Tomorrow is yesterday unless we change the pace.
synopsis: Two astronomers at a high-altitude desert observatory discover that a minor solar anomaly has trapped their valley in a twelve-hour daylight loop. Together, they test wild scientific pranks while searching for the solar trigger.

name: Bridge of Lanterns
tagline: The song remains long after the festival closes.
synopsis: A young puppeteer from a canal village accidentally activates a luminous bridge made of festival lanterns leading to an ancestral cloud citadel. Partnering with a mischievous spirit mask, she searches for her grandmother's lost ballad.

name: The Orbital Arc
tagline: A single light in the fathomless dark.
synopsis: When solar flares destabilize the orbital mirrors keeping arctic megacities warm, an experienced maintenance astronaut takes a risky sling-shot path to the sun. Confronting extreme radiation and isolation, he races to realign the solar array.

name: The Terrace Cipher
tagline: Two worlds collide beneath the marble stairs.
synopsis: A resourceful family of theatrical prop designers secures jobs managing the estate of an elusive software mogul. As they gradually furnish the mansion with fabricated antiques, they uncover secret vaults concealing financial espionage.

name: The Clockwork Haven
tagline: Even broken gears can turn a wondrous town.
synopsis: An eccentric botanist's mechanical assistant is wrongly accused of tampering with the town watermill. With the help of an optimistic street baker, the brass creature sets out on an airborne chase to recover the stolen blueprints.

name: Strato Apex
tagline: At Mach four, instincts rule the sky.
synopsis: A legendary civilian test pilot is called out of retirement to fly an uncrewed solar glider prototype through hurricane jet streams. Teaming up with a brilliant rookie flight engineer, they push aerodynamic physics to the edge.

name: Meridian Drift
tagline: Separated by oceans, reunited by a single train.
synopsis: Two architecture students who spent a summer drafting coastal lighthouses cross paths twenty years later at a railway terminal in Zurich. Over twenty-four hours, they reflect on choices made, families built, and paths left behind.

name: Ember Tide
tagline: The oldest melodies guide the farthest voyages.
synopsis: An apprentice navigator on a volcanic archipelago preserves oral sailing anthems while competing in the oceanic festival. When a storm threatens the harvest trade, her family's ancestral chants become the fleet's only beacon.

name: Crag Wanderers
tagline: Off the trail and beyond all rules.
synopsis: A bookish teenager and a stubborn mountain goat herder are cut off by a canyon rockslide in the rugged high country. Evading overzealous wilderness rangers, the mismatched pair embarks on an accidental cross-country expedition.

name: The Glass Expanse
tagline: In the desert of silica, kings are made of dust.
synopsis: Across a glassy silica plain raked by lightning storms, nomadic sand-skiff sailers band together to resist mineral mining cartels. A young sailmaster learns the wind patterns to launch an airborne counter-offensive.
